why: L1.pause-induced-sentence-breaks: Parakeet ends a sentence at a mid-clause pause, leaving a fragment and a spurious capital.
behaviour: the speech recogniser has broken two or three sentences at a mid-clause pause, leaving a full stop and a spurious capital inside one sentence ("One failure pattern. Is that I start a sentence, stop, and continue it.", "I'll send it over. Once the client signs.")
rule: Rejoin a sentence the recogniser broke at a pause: remove the false full stop and lower-case the next word ("One failure pattern is that I start a sentence..."). Leave genuine short sentences alone.
